name: Data & State Persistence
description: Data fetching, mutation, persistence operations, and client-side state management

knowledge.purpose: App-scoped data fetch, mutation, and cache layer that backs surface bindings and state stores
useCases: List or table backed by an entity collection
Form submit that creates or updates an entity
Optimistic UI update with rollback on failure
Cached read across multiple components on the same surface
antiPatterns: Client-only ephemeral UI state — use client form state instead
Queries across apps — persistence is always scoped to one app
Unbounded background polling — prefer event-driven invalidation

fields.label: Max Retries
fields.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests

fields.label: Storage Key
fields.description: Local storage key prefix for persisted state
